name: chat-sidebar
title: Chat Sidebar
description: The history panel of a chat app: a New chat key, a search well, and threads grouped Pinned, Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days and on by month. The open thread is a raised segment that glides between rows. Each row's ⋯ key unfolds a menu (Share, Rename, Pin, Archive, Delete) that scales out of the key as its blur clears, with a gliding highlight and a small gesture on every icon. Icons by Hugeicons.
